senses.gloss: male (of man and animals), male child; opp. נקבה.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 3:7">Nidd. III, 7</cite> <he>תשב לז׳ וכ׳</he> she shall observe the laws as after the birth of a male child &c. (<cite ref="Leviticus 12:4">Lev. XII, 4</cite>).
<cite ref="Leviticus 12:4">Ib.</cite> <he>בריית הז׳</he> the formation of the male embryo.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 9:2:2">Y. B. Bath. IX, 16ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>שמחת ז׳</he> the rejoicing over the birth of a boy; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>זְכָרִים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:3">Zeb. V, 3</cite>, a. fr. <he>זִכְרֵי כהונה</he> the male members of the priestly tribe.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13:13">Gen. R. s. 13</cite>, a. e. <he>המים העליונים ז׳ וכ׳</he> the waters from above are the males (fructifiers), &c.

senses.gloss: (v. דְּכַר II) (של רחלים) ז׳ the male of the flock, ram.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 5:3">Shek. V, 3</cite> <he>ז׳ משמש עם וכ׳</he> that with the inscription ‘male’ was used only for libations connected with rams.—Pl. as above.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 3:4">R. Hash. III, 4</cite>, sq. <he>בשל ז׳</he> with horns of rams; a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 4:6">Tosef. Bekh. IV, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00117"><he>זוּבָּן</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (of inanimate objects) the thinner, pointed side of a double tool, v. זַכְרוּת.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:2">Kel. XIII, 2</cite> <he>הז׳</he> the pointed side of the cosmetic tube, contrad. to <he>כף</he> the broad part.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 7:12">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VII, 12</cite>. [<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 7:12">Ib.</cite>
Kidd. 2ᵇ אשכחן דרך דאיקרי ל׳ ז׳ we find (in the Bible) derekh in the masculine gender. Mekh. B’shall., Shirah 1 בל׳ ז׳ in the masculine form (שִׁיר); Cant. R. to I, 5; a. e.
